The stack was landed, latched and tested with 50 kips overpull. Ran Phase PIT to 500 psi and held pressure 15 minutes with no leaks detected. Tagged cement at 427 m, drilled cement, float collar, float shoe, and in of new hole. The Phase II PIT

ght was raised to 10 ppg to provide additional overbalance while tripping. The yield point was also increased to provide better hole clean- ing. Two trips were required to pull to the casing shoe. On the second try the drill pipe had to be reamed and pumped out of the hole. The hole had to be reamed to bottom due to bridges. The well was terminated at 1932 after penetrating 24 of Danian Chalk.
